ld:
Notepad Vita is a simple note-taking app for the PS Vita.
Notepad Vita uses both the touch screen and the buttons to navigate the menus with a clean and modern look.
On the left side you can see a list with all your notes and on the right side the preview of the selected note.
It supports multi-line keyboard for easy note editing.
Your notes are saved in ux0:/data/Notes/ in .txt format.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
